as_told.title: UFO cover-up began as a presidential emergency action document

plain: The claim is that in the 1950s President Eisenhower set up secret emergency orders that, among other things, cover UFOs, which the subject calls UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena. These are presidential emergency action documents: orders a president keeps ready for a crisis, which few people ever see. A physicist named Eric W. Davis, presented on the show as a Pentagon scientist, says the directives are "so strict" and were "instituted in the Eisenhower White House". He says they have since been carried forward on many topics, and that he and a former CIA officer named Jim Semivan know they were set up for this one. A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron tells it too, also crediting Semivan, but he does not name Eisenhower. He goes further: "This is how it started, which means it's an executive program. The president is running the cover up." Both men are passing on what Semivan told them, not reading from the directives themselves. If true, keeping UFOs secret would be a matter of presidential command, not something a lower agency did on its own.
